title: Earth and Stone - Ain't That Loving You

lines.l: You think I love you, for just one thing
To you, my love, this may be the way it seems
But I love the way you carry yourself
I even love you, I love you, I love you for what you may become
Ain't that love in you, yeah, that's the same
Inspired the things that the other man said
But I love the way you carry your day
I even love you, I love you, I love you for the way you wave your hair
Ain't that loving you, yeah, got to say
Did it ever occur to you
But I love you for what you are.
I even love you, I love you, I love you for what you made me from.
For far more reasons than I want
